reviews.author: anshika
reviews.text: Yesterday we went there for lunch, we had to look for people if we wanted something. We have been waiving at the staffs but they were hardly paying attention to their customers. Once they serve your order, they forgot that you are sitting. Customer may need something more or would like to order more. But they just want us to finish and go. They don't pay attention to their customers at all, when we told one of the lady staffs when she came with bill, she didn't even apologise or said that anything? Is this the way you people treat your customers? So it doesn't matter that u lose one customer but I will tell more people about your customer service! Not coming back again! We pay for food n service and they were hardly good at both! 👎🏻also a lot of flies there.. irritation while eating, dirty washroom.

details.parking: The restaurant,  for the capacity that it runs with, doesn't have sufficient parking space. The security guard was a bit rude to all of us... esp bikers.
